content.text: Waking at 2am is pretty common at 8 — sleep cycles lighten around that hour and kids this age often surface, especially if anything's shifted in their routine or they're anxious about school or friendships. Try a short, boring check-in when it happens: reassure her you're there, keep lights off, and walk straight back out so staying up doesn't become the reward.

input.offer: Want the full plan for getting Ada back to sleeping through? Reply YES and I'll send it.
